Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of ASUS TUF Gaming F15 (FX507ZV)?

The ASUS TUF Gaming F15 (FX507ZV) features a 140W Max TGP (with Dynamic Boost, MUX Switch + Advanced Optimus) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

ASUS TUF Gaming F15 (FX507ZV) scores 9.7/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i7-13620H (10 Cores, 16 Threads, up to 4.9 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
